messages:
Hannah: Quick thread: need a lightweight playbook for guided quant + batching recs. Customers want clear safe steps not magic.
Omar: Agreed. Proposal: three phases - Preview (simulate), Staging apply (opt-in), Production apply (canary + monitor).
Kelsey: For MVP keep batching presets simple: low-latency, balanced, throughput. Let teams edit batch_size and target_p99.
Hannah: Minimal safety checks: reject quant profile if sample eval accuracy delta > 0.8% or latency improves < 10% savings.
Omar: Engineering: we'll expose SDK flag optimize.batch_preset and optimize.quant_profile_id. Need infra for nightly sample evals and a webhook on regressions.
InfraBot: Note: canary policy must include traffic split 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on metric bump > 10% error rate.
EvalsBot: Latest run: customer EduSpace sample fail rate 0.2%. Suggested alert threshold 0.5%. Link: https://internal.evals/4981
Kelsey: Acceptance checklist: spec doc, UI mock, SDK flag, canary script, E2E eval-alert test, legal opt-in copy.
Hannah: I'll assemble the playbook doc and share link by EOD. Tagging @Omar for timeline. :thumbsup:
Omar: ETA 2 squads, 6w if parallelized. +1 on beta cohort (EduSpace, ShopLoop).
Kelsey: +1. Keeping notify-only for beta alerts.
Hannah: Great, locking this and will post doc.
